Step by step

How it works

Four steps. The one that used to take a Saturday takes about four minutes, and every output is traceable to a page you can look at.

Join the early list

The four steps

  1. Upload the case documents

    Add the institutional document and the governing document — a denial letter and the policy, an IEP and the evaluation, an itemised bill and the plan. Faxed, scanned, photographed, duplicated and out of order are all normal and all handled. Deduplication runs first, because provider and carrier productions are full of repeats.

  2. Review the extracted timeline

    Before any analysis, Countercite shows you a dated timeline of what happened and who said what, with every entry linked to its source page. You fix anything misread. This step exists because analysis built on a misread date is worse than no analysis.

  3. Work the contradiction list

    Each finding is stated in three parts: what the governing document says, what the institution did, and precisely where they disagree — with both passages shown side by side. Findings are ranked by the dollar value or the legal weight at stake, not by the order they were found.

  4. Generate and edit the letter

    Countercite drafts the argument in your own template and house style, with a citation on every factual assertion. You edit, you approve, you send. It is your work product and your professional judgement, and the tool never sends anything itself.

What happens to your documents

Encrypted in transit and at rest

Standard, and worth stating plainly because your clients will ask you and you need an answer.

Never used for training

Your client documents produce your work product. They are not training data, they are not shared, and they are not pooled.

Deleted when you say

Per-case deletion on demand, and automatic deletion on a schedule you set. Closed cases do not need to sit on someone else's server forever.

Questions about the process

What if it reads a document wrong?
You see the extracted timeline before analysis runs, and every finding links to its source page. The design assumption is that it will sometimes be wrong and that you must be able to catch it in seconds.
How long does a case take to process?
A typical two-document case is minutes. A thousand-page medical production is longer and runs in the background while you work on something else.
Can I use my own letter templates?
Yes, and on the Practice plan and above your templates become the default so drafts arrive in your house style.

Try it on a case you already know the answer to

It is the only test that tells you anything. Fourteen days free when it opens, and no card to join the list.
